#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <deque>
#include <utility>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

long long genUnos(long long n) {
    return (long long)(pow(10.0, n) - 1) / 9;
}

long long progIter(long long n, int tam) {
    deque<pair<long long, int>> stack;
    stack.push_back({n, tam});
    long long result = 0;
    while (!stack.empty()) {
        auto state = stack.back();
        stack.pop_back();
        long long curN = state.first;
        int curTam = state.second;
        long long unos = genUnos(1 + curTam);
        long long veces = curN / unos * (1 + curTam);
        curN %= unos;
        if (curN == 0) {
            result += veces;
        } else {
            // do nothing (incomplete)
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long long num;
    cin >> num;
    int tam = (int)(log10(abs(num))) + 1;
    cout << progIter(num, tam) << endl;
    return 0;
}
